description: A location associated with the user's professional profile. Supports multiple locations per user (e.g. residential, business, travel).

main.description: A single location entry in the user's profile.

address.description: Location address using community location lexicon.

label.description: Optional user-defined label for this location.

isPrimary.description: Whether this is the primary/display location.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when this record was created.
